stories.title: Local investigators skirt what they say are federal blocks in Austin ICE shooting probe
stories.summary: Sources say investigators have relied upon a series of search warrants, subpoenas and cellphone tower data to try to identify the agent involved.

stories.title: Robert Bond vanished from a Houston townhome in 2024. His family fears he'll never come home
stories.summary: Robert Bond disappeared from a Galleria-area townhome in June 2024. His mother says the family has slowly come to believe he is dead.

stories.title: Forecast: Chilliest morning since March on the way for Central Texas
stories.summary: Here are the latest updates from the KVUE Weather Impact Team.

stories.title: 'Sitting on a tarmac with no money': Banking disruptions add to string of major U.S. tech outages
stories.summary: Thousands reported banking issues Monday after a Chase software bug caused delays, potentially affecting transactions involving other major banks.

stories.title: Mayor Watson creates advisory board to assess the future of professional sports in Austin
stories.summary: Watson's office said Austin is the largest U.S. metro area without a professional football, basketball or baseball team.

stories.title: Some Fort Hood shooting survivors denied chance to witness gunman's execution
stories.summary: The man convicted of the 2009 Fort Hood shooting is set to be executed by firing squad on Dec. 3. Some victims are being told they don't qualify to witness it.

stories.title: USDA awards $5M to Safe Summers Foundation after Camp Mystic flood tragedy
stories.summary: The foundation gives grants to camps that need money or technical help to meet new safety standards.

stories.title: CapMetro moves forward with $51M Plaza Saltillo rail expansion
stories.summary: Currently, the station can accommodate only one train on a single track. The expansion will add a second track, allowing up to four trains to be at the station.

stories.title: Flight canceled, rental cars unavailable: Man rents U-Haul to drive 1,200 miles from Austin to Minneapolis
stories.summary: After struggling to find another flight or rental car after widespread flight disruptions, Greg Swan turned to an unconventional solution to get home to his family.

stories.title: Austin's chief medical officer is stepping down
stories.summary: Dr. Desmar Walkes will serve as the interim EMS System Medical Director while the city searches for a permanent replacement for Dr. Mark Escott.

stories.title: 3 San Marcos police officers cleared in deadly June shooting at apartment complex
stories.summary: A Hays County grand jury did not return an indictment against the officers after the death of 25-year-old Thomas Anthony Hawkins III.

stories.title: Austin airport says 183 departing flights were canceled from Friday to Sunday after nationwide ground stop
stories.summary: The airport said lingering impacts from Friday's ground stop have come in the form of changes to flight schedules and unclaimed bags at airports nationwide.
